soft paper-white bounce, deep blacks with retained material detail, composed

boards, server racks, excessive glow, rainbow gradients, stock developer art
Brand fidelity: follow the PliegoCSS visual system exactly. Preserve square joins, engineered-paper tactility, restrained cobalt structure, and a single cyan lineage cue. The result must feel like an authored premium editorial artifact, never generic AI developer imagery.
